about.heading: About me
paragraphs: I'm Edner Emmanuel, founder of Photo NationX. I photograph and film the moments people want to keep, and I help turn an idea into something they can see.

I started as a kid with a camera at my hip. Parties, dance shows, birthdays, vacations. If friends or family were there, I was there to catch it. The joy on their faces is what made me decide to go pro.

The beginning was hard. Nobody wanted to hire a photographer without a portfolio, so I spent about three years shooting for free while I taught myself, course by course and job by job. The first wedding that paid me was a full day, two venues, and a couple hundred guests. Most of that fee went to the people helping me shoot and edit. I took the job anyway, because I needed the work to exist.

Word of mouth did the rest. I got serious about the craft and about getting the pictures and video back while the moment was still fresh, sometimes thousands of photos and an edited film before a couple came home from the honeymoon. That is still how I work. Photo NationX is portraits, events, marketing, and film, built by learning the job and not giving up.
